name: Le Vent Souffle
source:
“Every day feels the same.”

Yuuto lives a quiet and monotonous life, feeling disconnected from the world around him. Everything begins to change when Rei unexpectedly enters his life.

Le Vent Souffle is a short, narrative-driven visual novel about loneliness, emotional healing, and human connection, told through a calm and introspective story.
